mapper.select: SELECT regId AS "regId", userId AS "userId", carNum AS "carNum", ownerName AS "ownerName", startDate AS "startDate", endDate AS "endDate", type, status, createdAt AS "createdAt" FROM prepaid WHERE UPPER(status) = 'APPROVED' AND startDate <= CURRENT_DATE AND endDate >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY regId DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prepaid WHERE UPPER(status) = 'APPROVED' AND startDate <= CURRENT_DATE AND endDate >= CURRENT_DATE

SELECT regId AS "regId", userId AS "userId", carNum AS "carNum", ownerName AS "ownerName", startDate AS "startDate", endDate AS "endDate", type, status, createdAt AS "createdAt", price FROM prepaid WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY regId DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prepaid ( userId, carNum, ownerName, startDate, endDate, type, price, status, createdAt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{carNum}, #{ownerName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{type}, #{price}, 'requested', NOW() )
